description: Netlify provides a REST API to manage site deployments, forms, DNS, environment variables, and other hosting features.
access_requirements: Free tier self‑serve (generate personal access token)
evidence_excerpts: "Netlify uses OAuth2 for authentication ... To authenticate API requests, include the token in the authorization header: Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN>"
"If you’re making a public integration with Netlify for others to enjoy, you must use OAuth2."
"Use the Netlify REST API to manage atomic deploys of your sites and apps, manage form submissions, inject JavaScript snippets, manage DNS ... and so much more."
"Go to Applications > Personal access tokens . Use your PAT for manual authentication in shell scripts or commands that use the Netlify API."
